OrAction.doc: Conflict-resolution prefix on a write. Mirrors the SQL `OR <action>` clause: REPLACE, IGNORE, ABORT, FAIL, ROLLBACK. Parser-only; the compiler decides how to lower it.

Replace.doc: OR REPLACE — overwrite on uniqueness conflict.

Ignore.doc: OR IGNORE — skip the row on conflict.

Abort.doc: OR ABORT — default. Roll back the offending statement only.

Fail.doc: OR FAIL — abort the statement, leave prior changes.

Rollback.doc: OR ROLLBACK — abort the entire transaction.

UpdateAssignment.doc: Re-export of update-stmt's UpdateAssignment shape so the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE clause can carry a list of `col = expr` pairs without circular import. Kept as a local record (not imported) because shape.schema.json does not yet support back-references between sibling parts.

ConflictClause.doc: Body of an `ON CONFLICT (col_list) DO ...` clause. `target` is the column list naming the conflict target index (empty list = unspecified target — parser admits but compiler may reject).

DoNothing.doc: ON CONFLICT (...) DO NOTHING — silently skip conflicting rows.

DoUpdate.doc: ON CONFLICT (...) DO UPDATE SET col = expr [, ...] [WHERE expr] — UPSERT.

ResultColumn.doc: Item in a RETURNING clause. Mirrors a single-table projection: `*`, `t.*`, or `expr [AS alias]`.

Star.doc: `*` — every column of the affected row.

InsertStmt.doc: Parsed INSERT statement. Covers VALUES rows, INSERT-from-SELECT, DEFAULT VALUES, OR-action conflict prefix, ON CONFLICT (UPSERT), and RETURNING. Exactly one of `default_values` / `from_select` / non-empty `rows` is set on a well-formed statement; the parser also admits `rows.is_empty() && from_select.is_none() && !default_values` only as an internal transient — error path.

InsertRow.doc: One row's worth of inserted expressions. Used only for VALUES-form INSERT.

InsertParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the InsertStmt plus the position of the next token after the statement.

parse_insert.doc: Parse an INSERT statement starting at `tokens[start]`. Admits VALUES (single+multi-row), INSERT-from-SELECT, DEFAULT VALUES, OR-action prefix, ON CONFLICT (... ) DO NOTHING / DO UPDATE, and RETURNING. Delegates to `parse_expr` for value/where exprs, and to `parse_select` for the SELECT body of INSERT-from-SELECT.
